title: Crew Access Note: Stairs on Business Route Pickups (Northgate Purchases & Returns)
content:
For the route pickup fee that Northgate Purchases & Returns invoices on the changed-mind freight pickup of special-order merchandise for a Northgate Business Membership or Northgate Business Plus Membership, the crew's stair work is priced from the delivery that brought the merchandise.

## Stair charge on the route pickup

When the delivery appointment that delivered the purchase charged two or more flights of stairs, 30.00 is added to the route pickup fee; when it charged exactly one flight, 15.00 is added; otherwise nothing is added.

The flights counted are the stair-carry flights charged on the Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment that delivered the purchase, that is, the total units of its stair-carry service charges.

| Stair-carry flights charged on the delivering appointment | Added to the route pickup fee |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 30.00 |
| exactly 1 | 15.00 |
| none, or no Northgate delivery appointment | nothing |

## Points of judgement

- The flights are those the delivery appointment charged, as its stair-carry charges show, summed over all of them; three flights charged in two entries count as three.
- Hypothetical: a delivery that charged one stair-carry flight adds 15.00; a delivery that charged four adds 30.00, the top band having no further step.
